**Type:** Reddit community post (r/AIReceptionistOwners, 2026 ranking)
**Headline:** "The 10 best AI receptionists for trade businesses in 2026"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "The cost of a missed call is not one missed call. It's one missed customer plus a referral handed to whoever you're competing with. What's the..."

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- Missed call = missed customer + missed referral (the network-effect multiplier)
- Trades owners shopping for AI receptionists are now comparing 10+ vendors side-by-side
- "The competition is whoever picks up first" — the unit-economics framing

### Why this works:
The "one missed customer plus a referral handed to whoever you're competing with" framing is the strongest Pillar 2 hook variation since the persona's "$1M/year" anchor. It scales the unit economics: 1 missed call = 1 lost customer + 1 lost referral (each customer refers ~1-2 others over time) + 8 years of repeat service. The math isn't $450. The math is $4,200+. **This is the same hook the 2026-06-18 brief used, but the Reddit source (vs the earlier Sohu) is more directly quotable for the US trades audience.**
